name: Airbus orders and deliveries
description: Monthly workbook with customer orders, deliveries and aircraft in fleet. Historical versions are retained.

name: Boeing orders and deliveries
description: Public Tableau export. Its reporting cutoff is unknown; retrieval date is shown separately.

name: Manufacturer, airline and lessor announcements
description: Dated contracts, options and commitments. Reconcile customer and group allocations before calculating a combined backlog.

name: B787 Register
description: Independent aircraft histories. Reported milestones retain attribution and do not automatically confirm operational stages.

name: Planespotters.net
description: Production lists and aircraft identities for cross-checking. Automated ingestion requires permission.

name: Enthusiast sightings and photographs
description: Original dated sightings, photos and production logs. Photos are linked at their source. Reposts count as one observation.

name: ch-aviation
description: Order and aircraft histories, rollout, first flight and delivery dates. Reviewed export import is supported; no account connected.

name: Cirium Fleets Analyzer
description: Fleet, ownership and aircraft histories. Reviewed export import is supported; provider mapping needs a licensed sample.

name: Flightradar24 API
description: Historical flight evidence can corroborate activity. No API account connected; flights alone do not establish first flight or acceptance.

name: adsb.fi and adsb.lol
description: Existing movement feeds with freshness checks. Their live availability appears in the dashboard header.
